mainEntity.name: Do I really need Google Business Profile optimization if I already have a website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely. While a website is crucial for providing detailed information and converting leads, Google Business Profile serves as your digital storefront on Google Search and Maps. Many customers use Google directly to find local businesses, and your GBP is often the first point of contact. An optimized profile ensures you appear in these critical local searches, driving traffic to your website, generating direct calls, and increasing foot traffic. It acts as a powerful, distinct marketing channel that complements your website by capturing local intent.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, GBP is essential. It acts as your digital storefront on Google Search and Maps, capturing local customer intent and driving traffic to your website and physical location.
